title: Decentralized Notice Board
tagline: This Decentralized Notice Board is used for mainly post notices by colleges and schools .
description: This project is mainly used for post Notices by colleges and companies in form of NFTs. This is mainly made for not spreading rumors of false Notice. It is proof of real Notice by the college and company. Everyone should believe in this Notice because it for minting it charges some high money for proof that your upload notice is valuable, not fake.
how_its_made: This project is made by using Html, css, and javascript for frontend development. I used Moralis for connecting the wallet. With the help of Moralis, this project deploys in the Polygon blockchain. I done my project by solo , I have no any partner , I know only frontend web development but by the use of Moralis I able to connect wallet with metamask successfully on polygon blockchain. Moralis is best for using in backend.
